integrity: The counterexample is an exact coordinate construction on \(\ell^2\). The repaired equivalence was checked from the definitions of a \(K\)-frame and the Douglas range theorem; the closed-range repair was checked using the bounded inverse of the analysis operator on \(\ker(T_F)^\perp\). No computational extrapolation is used.
limitations: The correction concerns the analysis-range boundedness in Theorems 3.8--3.9 of the cited 2023 paper. It does not classify every special setting in which the restriction of the diagonal multiplier is bounded, and it does not assert that later results with stronger atom-size hypotheses fail.
title: Unbounded diagonal scaling exposes a closed-range boundary for K-frame characterizations
